The Supreme Court striking down Biden’s authoritarian vaccine mandates on businesses is a win for freedom and American values. 

However, we will not rest until ALL vaccine mandates are struck down. No one should be mandated to choose between their job and medical freedom.

You know what else is “risky?”

Ignoring the negative impacts that Covid regulations have had on the education and mental health of our children.

#UNMASKOURCHILDREN 

https://t.co/izwU0NOtRU
The American people should have ALWAYS been able to make their own medical decisions.

I am proud to introduce the No Patient Left Alone Act with my fellow GOP Doctors Caucus Colleague @RepAndyHarrisMD. 

Hospitals should not be able to restrict patients from seeing their loved ones during such a critical time. https://t.co/EjVvd85yws

Yesterday, I joined my Republican colleagues to discuss the irreversible consequences of medical professionals performing gender-affirming surgeries on minors. 

I am proud to co-sponsor the Protect Children’s Innocence Act and will fight to end this abuse on our children. https://t.co/M2GxHS5w0u

When it comes to reining in spending, I want to be clear: making cuts to Social Security or Medicare, programs that hard-working Americans have spent their lives paying their fair share towards, is something that will never even be a consideration.

Despite President Biden declaring "the pandemic is over" in September, his Admin extended the Public Health Emergency yet AGAIN earlier this month.

The pandemic is over.

The emergency is over.

Time to rein in this administration's pandemic powers.

Our essential healthcare workers never deserved to lose their jobs because of authoritarian vaccine mandates.

Proud of @HouseGOP for lifting this mandate.

Joe Biden announced a "Unity Agenda" during his first State of the Union, yet last night he:

-LIED about R's wanting to cut Social Security and Medicare
-BLAMED Trump for increasing debt
-TOOK FULL CREDIT for reopening the nation after Covid

Not very unifying, was it?

4 unidentified objects shot down in 8 days. 

An Ohio train derailed resulting in a toxic chemical spill with untold health impacts for thousands of Americans. 

Americans are scared. 

The President, our Commander-in-Chief, must publicly address these emergencies immediately.

I’m on the ground in Yuma with @BPUnion, law enforcement, medical staff, and locals to see the #BidenBorderCrisis firsthand. 

Despite having almost a month’s notice, none of my Dem colleagues showed up, labeling it a “stunt.”

Why won’t they come see their self-created crisis?

One hospital, three ambulances, and thousands of illegal immigrants in need of assistance. 

President Biden's open border entices migrants to make the dangerous trek to our country, and the care they need prevents Americans from receiving timely healthcare in Yuma, AZ.

In 2022, Mar-a-Lago was RAIDED by 30 FBI agents.

But when classified documents belonging to Biden were found in NUMEROUS places, there was no raid, no heavy media coverage, and no large team of agents digging through his personal items.

Why the disparate treatment @FBI?

Millions of Americans who rely on pistol braces to exercise their 2nd Amendment rights are at risk of being felons thanks to Biden's ATF.
 
This is an egregious overstep by DC bureaucrats & I was proud to vote YES on @Rep_Clyde’s bill to nullify this unconstitutional ruling.

. @RepTroyNehls is absolutely right. This country has a two-tiered justice system. If you're a conservative, they'll throw the book at you, but if your last name is Biden they'll give you sweetheart plea deals and special treatment. https://t.co/qT7EGxyuDj

The VA is meant to take care of American veterans, not illegal immigrants. This gross misuse of resources is not only unacceptable, but a disservice to the men and women who selflessly served this great nation.

Our veterans deserve better.
https://t.co/VkfRdBtXOA

This is the first step in eventually allowing millions of illegal immigrants to have access to taxpayer funded healthcare.
 
Biden continues to incentivize illegal crossings and continues to put hardworking Americans last.

Our heroes have sacrificed so much for our country, and it is our duty to support them with the best healthcare possible.

These new facilities would provide better access to quality care, especially in rural areas. 

America’s veterans deserve nothing less than the best.

This is absolutely insane.

New Jersey hospitals are handing parents forms asking if their newborn baby is bisexual or even transgender—a one-day-old infant.

And it’s state law, paid for by your hard earned taxpayer dollars. 
https://t.co/7w2lcI1T4E

My office is closely monitoring the forest fire in Ocean County, NJ.

While the fire has still not been fully contained, evacuation orders have been lifted, and the Garden State Parkway has reopened. We urge everyone to exercise caution when traveling through the area.

Thank you to the dedicated NJ Forest Fire Service and all the brave fire companies who worked tirelessly through the night to keep our communities safe.
https://t.co/LMPmg9Y6j5

I am very sorry to hear about President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. 

No matter our politics, I hope he gets the care and support he needs for a full recovery.
https://t.co/t0bMdsPWq0

I spoke with @realDonaldTrump this morning, and he was clear: don’t hurt our hospitals, don’t hurt Medicaid, and don’t hurt hardworking Americans. 

Focus on cutting the waste, fraud, and abuse.

Now it’s time for Congress to get this done the right way.

We won’t be dictated by an unelected bureaucrat.

The Senate parliamentarian blocked a provision that would stop Medicaid dollars from going to illegal aliens.

That’s why I introduced the No Medicaid for Illegals Act—to make sure American taxpayer dollars go only to Americans.

The health of our nation starts with the health of our children. 

That’s why I’ll be introducing a bill to codify President Trump’s order restoring the Presidential Fitness Test—so we can Make America Healthy Again.
https://t.co/MyDTy1VS06

Day 3 of the Democrat Shutdown.

Because Democrats care more about giving free healthcare to illegal immigrants than they do about their own citizens. https://t.co/mLkV4QtSLq
